detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Warning: This game is not intended for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

Sniper Camouflage Orange Spy Warrior I Buried Two Bodies in the Garden and the Police Haven't Figured Out Yet That They're Missing Because They Were a Lonely Old Couple Who Had No Relatives Simulator 2026

Abbreviated as SCOSWIBTBITGATPHFOYTTMBTWALOCWHNRS2026, or simply Sniper Simulator 2026, or it could also be LSD: Sniper Simulator. IIt's a unique sandbox sniper simulator that blends first-person point-and-click with immersive physics-based object manipulation.

The game features various side activities and a world full of hidden secrets. Your main task is to kill the designated targets, isn't it? But it won't be easy.

Even though the targets aren't particularly dangerous, your main enemies as a sniper are gravity (bullet drop) and wind (sidewind), just like a sniper in real life, requiring you to carefully interact with your environment and equipment to pull off the perfect shot.

Sniper gameplay (Windage and Elevation)

One day I was playing Sniper Ghost Warrior 3 and realized the game was way too easy. It occurred to me to make it a little more autistic and retarded, Instead of the bullet flying in the direction the scope is pointing, you have to adjust the scope yourself based on the wind and the distance to the target. SGW shows you the distance and actively displays the crosswind, but my game doesn't do that, you have to figure it out yourself the old-fashioned way, just like snipers do in real life (it's definitely not a 1:1 match).

Simply put, the scope doesn't tell you where the bullet will land, and you don't change the bullet's range in any way during the game. On the contrary, thanks to the scope settings, it tells you the exact direction of the bullet's impact if the target is at the distance you've set, and the same goes for crosswinds.

Windage is a correction for the wind's drift

Elevation is the correction for a bullet's trajectory based on distance

Customize your sniper spot as your home base

In the game, you can only shoot from certain sniper spots. Since they’re all the same, you can upgrade your sniper spot with decorations and other cool features, including some bonuses. Examples:

  • A radio that plays your music from a folder

  • A cell phone that can play videos

  • A drawing board where you can draw anything

  • A slot machine or other items that let you gamble or get ammo in addition to what’s in the game world

  • Then there are decorations that give you bonuses, like a playground that confuses snipers for a longer period of time

Side Activities

In addition to the main quests in the game, there are also a number of side activities, such as:

  • time trials, cargo races, and stunts

  • time-based parkour

  • boat races

  • climbing

  • special levels, such as one with a sniper spot mounted on a car (see the gameplay video)

Key elements:

  • hand interaction, game requires magazine change bolt movement with mouse etc..

  • Unique graphics and styling

  • side quests and secrets outside the main quest

  • Editor (not yet)

  • Realistic ballistics: distance, wind drift, and manual scope calibration.
